frozen_design.name: D one fixed1024 moderation check on higher short-background workload
frozen_design.question: Does one ordinary intermediate fixed budget absorb the observed prefill-wait versus cumulative-generation tradeoff?
frozen_design.primary_changed_factor: Only constant pure-prefill cap1024 versus2048. Exactly pressure01 external input, model, BF16, normal KV, native rules and parent driver.
frozen_design.input_generation: build_more_decode.py; seed2026100802; added96 independent uniform0-40s; original16templates repeated6times each; fixed384output. Prepared before upper01 results. Not independent confirmation.
frozen_design.reason: pressure01 fixed2048 reaches256/256 qualification but mean generation duration increases1.716/1.763s versus384 while meanTTFT falls2.517/2.515s; actual cap changes executed356/350 steps above384. This larger cumulative cost motivates a single existing native midpoint before investing in any selector. The maxgap relative guard includes a pure-decode scheduling tail event and is not claimed as a stable mixed-prefill bottleneck.
frozen_design.geometry: maxlen4025. Largest192 terminal KV ceilings in16tokenblocks=36664 versus prior36764usable, margin100blocks. Geometric bound only, not measured resident state/native admission guarantee.
frozen_design.decision: First require actual execution differences. One fixed cap is provisionally sufficient for the primary objective if its fulljointgoodput improves>=3% in both reversedpairs, allrequestscomplete, rawthroughputdoesnotdecrease, and TTFT/flow/maxgap p95 do not worsen>5%, with noadded100msgapfailures. Otherwise report the completefixedfrontier and whether tradeoff signs repeat; noisy/mixed signs are inconclusive. Only a reproducible tradeoff plus observable state variation warrants count/closest-dynamic comparisons and a new signal. No controller or intermediate-cap grid; same gates retained. All qualification changes reported.
frozen_design.interpretation: Fresh fixed-baseline tuning on an already observed development workload, not independent confirmation. Fourformal cap1024/2048/2048/1024, no cap grid or automatic repeats. Preserve original3% effect and all raw/gap/TTFT/flow guards. If1024 fully wins, retain simple fixed explanation. If2048 fully wins or1024 sacrifices qualification/throughput without new state-specific evidence, stop midpoint/threshold search. A residual descriptive frontier alone is insufficient to invent a selector.
frozen_design.execution: Unmodified parent run_confirmation.py/launch.sh; cap-only native patch. Existing no-preempt/all-decoder-service checks remain; any failure is a preserved observation failure, not a negative performance result.
frozen_design.resources: Shared physical hostflock; oneD task only;7200s wait;2warm4formalgroup; releaseonexit. Keep4GiBprelaunch diskreserve. No costtelemetry.

scope: Two reversed pairs on one fresh development arrival, not statistical confirmation. All requests and full elapsed retained; fixed prompt/output counts are not content, routing, computation or quality equivalence. No per-window oracle or controller claim. Mixed signs remain inconclusive; a missing uniform winner alone is not evidence for dynamics.
